birre-alla-spina-03.name: Warsteiner German Lager 33cl
birre-alla-spina-03.description: Light, pale straw-coloured lager with moderate strength. Intense hop aroma with notes of barley caramel; a hint of fresh bread followed by a lasting, pleasantly bitter hop finish. 4.8% ABV

birre-alla-spina-04.name: Warsteiner German Lager 40cl
birre-alla-spina-04.description: Light, pale straw-coloured lager with moderate strength. Intense hop aroma with notes of barley caramel; a hint of fresh bread followed by a lasting, pleasantly bitter hop finish. 4.8% ABV

birre-alla-spina-05.name: Budvar Original Lager 25cl
birre-alla-spina-05.description: Brewed since 1895 in its home town of České Budějovice, with 800 years of brewing tradition. A rich, flavourful Czech lager made with whole Saaz hops from Žatec, barley malt and traditional lager yeast: golden colour, medium body and a generous head. Bold yet refreshing and perfectly balanced.

birre-alla-spina-07.name: Budvar Original Lager 40cl
birre-alla-spina-07.description: Brewed since 1895 in its home town of České Budějovice, with 800 years of brewing tradition. A rich, flavourful Czech lager made with whole Saaz hops from Žatec, barley malt and traditional lager yeast: golden colour, medium body and a generous head. Bold yet refreshing and perfectly balanced.

birre-alla-spina-08.name: Budvar Original Lager 50cl
birre-alla-spina-08.description: Brewed since 1895 in its home town of České Budějovice, with 800 years of brewing tradition. A rich, flavourful Czech lager made with whole Saaz hops from Žatec, barley malt and traditional lager yeast: golden colour, medium body and a generous head. Bold yet refreshing and perfectly balanced.

birre-alla-spina-09.name: Kwak Red 25cl
birre-alla-spina-09.description: Belgian amber beer with a fine, delicate and lasting head. Spicy and malty aromas; a perfect balance between sweet caramel malt and a bitter finish.

birre-alla-spina-10.name: Kwak Red 50cl
birre-alla-spina-10.description: Strong ale with a bold, intense character. Soft and generous, its bitterness is rounded off by the high alcohol content and pale malts, giving a velvety, smooth finish.

birre-alla-spina-11.name: BrewDog Punk IPA 40cl
birre-alla-spina-11.description: American-style IPA brewed with American and New Zealand hops: intense citrus and tropical aromas – grapefruit, passion fruit and pineapple. Fruity on the palate with a long, refreshing finish. An icon of the European craft beer revolution.

birre-alla-spina-12.name: Guinness 50cl
birre-alla-spina-12.description: Brewed with top-quality roasted malt for its signature near-black colour. Aromas of freshly roasted coffee; dry, bold and intense taste. Widely considered the world's number one stout, with a dense, creamy and long-lasting head.

birre-in-bottiglia-e-lattina-01.name: Weihenstephaner Hefeweissbier 50cl
birre-in-bottiglia-e-lattina-01.description: Bright golden wheat beer with fruity (banana and pineapple) and clove-spice aromas. Brewed in the German tradition: rich and fresh, with sweet notes of yeast and yellow fruit.

birre-in-bottiglia-e-lattina-02.name: Bavaria Holland Beer 50cl (can)
birre-in-bottiglia-e-lattina-02.description: Pale, natural lager made with nothing but barley malt and hops. 5% ABV

birre-in-bottiglia-e-lattina-04.name: Alcohol-Free Beer 0.0% 33cl (bottle)
birre-in-bottiglia-e-lattina-04.description: Pleasant hoppy notes, full and balanced flavour. A full-bodied beer despite being 0.0% alcohol.
